targets.title: Melanoma genome sequencing reveals frequent PREX2 mutations
targets.evidence_quote: As described in the Registered Report (Chroscinski et al., 2014), we attempted a replication of the experiments reported in Figures 3B and S6 of Berger et al. (2012).
targets.outcome_quote: Taken in context, the early onset of tumors in the control groups of this replication attempt effectively masks any potential effect of the PREX2 mutations being examined.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors state rapid tumor onset in controls masks the mutation effect, preventing a meaningful test of the central tumor-acceleration finding. Similar expression levels are preparatory checks. Reassaying original cell lines is new experimental measurement, not reanalysis of original data.
